# Component Import Backlog

Candidate parts for future import into `entries/`, ranked by how often they turn up in real hobbyist/maker projects (GitHub repos, Arduino/ESP32/Raspberry Pi forums, Reddit, Hackaday, beginner starter kits, and IoT platforms like ESPHome/Home Assistant/Tasmota) rather than raw distributor sales data. This is a **planning document, not entries** — nothing here has been imported yet. When it's time to import, follow `IMPORTING.md` per part as usual.

**Methodology:** generated by a multi-agent research workflow — 4 categories × 7 independent source-angles each (28 research agents), followed by one merge/deduplication/tiering pass per category (4 agents). Tiers are the merge agent's judgment call based on how many independent sources named a part and how essential it seemed, not a precise citation count.

## Tier definitions

| Tier | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **1 — Foundational** | Shows up across nearly every source cluster; a huge fraction of hobbyist projects use this or something functionally identical. Import these first. |
| **2 — Very common** | Appears repeatedly across multiple independent sources; solidly mainstream. |
| **3 — Common / specialized** | Real and genuinely used, but more niche, or supported by fewer independent sources in this research pass. |

## Summary

| Category | Tier 1 | Tier 2 | Tier 3 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Modules & sensors | 26 | 57 | 100 | 183 |
| ICs & transistors | 45 | 86 | 261 | 392 |
| Diodes, LEDs & passives | 15 | 40 | 119 | 174 |
| Electromechanical & connectors | 32 | 59 | 65 | 156 |
| **Total** | **118** | **242** | **545** | **905** |

905 distinct parts survived deduplication across all four categories — short of the 1000+ stretch target, but that's a real, deduplicated count rather than a padded one; going further would mean either weaker per-part evidence or another research round.

## Notes

- 2 part(s) above are already documented in this repo (marked "already in repo" in the Status column) and are listed only for completeness of the research picture — do not re-import them.
- This list has **not** been checked part-by-part for manufacturer disambiguation, second-sourcing, or datasheet availability — that diligence happens per `IMPORTING.md` at actual import time, not here. Treat this as a prioritized queue, not pre-verified entries.
- Some tier-3 entries are closely related variants of a tier-1/2 part (e.g. sibling relay coil voltages, sibling rectifier diodes in the same family) rather than independently "common" parts — use judgment when importing rather than treating every row as equally worth a separate entry.
